integrity: The total number of minimal dominating sets is prior-covered by OEIS A289121, and the scalar domination number is also not claimed as new. The retained claim is the complete structural classification and cardinality profile, together with the resulting upper-domination extremal count.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to ordinary inclusion-minimal domination in crown graphs with n at least 3. Exhaustive computation through n=9 is only a consistency check; the proof is symbolic for every n in the stated range.
title: Cardinality profile of minimal dominating sets in crown graphs
